# Cat Scratchbook

Source: anothereden.wiki, page "Cat Scratchbook" (saved 2026-11-20, revision 343355). Facts
only; no game art. The daily macro's data: `riddles.yaml` (clue -> place) and `cat_spots.yaml`
(how the app reaches each place); the project's own notes on the spots:
[learned/cat-scratchbook.md](../learned/cat-scratchbook.md).

## Unlocking

- Added in v3.7.10. Main Story Chapter 25 must be cleared; the unlock event starts by visiting
  the Spacetime Rift.
- The scratchbook's entries (clues) tell where cats out on walks are.

## Daily cats and stamps

- 1 to 3 cats a day, by scratchbook level; they reset at the daily reset. Campaigns can add one
  more.
- A cat can need finding up to 4 times a day: when it runs away, a new clue is given, and
  finding it again gives another stamp.
- A cat that can't be found any more is back in the Cats' Saucer: its portrait gets a stamp
  and its location is replaced by a message:

| Times found | Message |
|---|---|
| 1 | So, you have returned! I chose my assistant well! |
| 2 | Nya! I did think you would be returning home shortly, yes! |
| 3 | You took so long! I was worried! I won't let you go again, you hear me! |
| 4 | I've been beside myself with worry! But you finally made it back home! |

- Each find = 1 stamp. Up to 21 weekly stamps (capped by level); every 7th weekly stamp gives
  10 Majestic Furballs. Stamps over the weekly cap still count toward awards and apply if the
  cap rises.

## Levels

| Level | Main story | Stamps needed | Cat areas | Daily cats | Max weekly stamps | Max equipment level |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Ch.25 | 0 | Main Story 1.0 maps | 1 | 7 | 6 |
| 2 | Ch.44 | 5 | Main Story 1.5 maps | 2 | 14 | 11 |
| 3 | Ch.84 | 20 | Main Story 2.0 maps | 3 | 21 | 16 |

## Rewards per find

Finding the same cat more times in a day gives better rewards.

- 1-2 times: Medium Class Scroll x1-5, High Class Scroll x1-7, Frag. of Attack / Life /
  Support (stacks of 10, x1-15; only from scratchbook level 3), Git (stacks of 1k, x1-220),
  Murmur Script x1-3, Prayer Script x1-3, stat badges.
- 3 times: Red Key x2, Green Key x2, Cat Express Ticket x6.
- 4 times: 200 Chronos Stones (guaranteed; the page shows the stone icon).

## Cat Queen exchange

Majestic Furballs buy EXP equipment from the Cat Queen in the Cats' Saucer (several copies
allowed): EXP +20% at Lv01, +25% Lv06, +30% Lv11, +35% Lv16. Catqueen's Cane, Sword, Katana,
Ax, Lance, Bow, Fists, Hammer, Brace, Chain and Ring.

## Awards

Rookie Cat Finder (find 5 cats: 5 Chronos Stones), Veteran Cat Finder (20 cats: 10), Master Cat
Finder (50 cats: 20).

"Enter from X": the place is reached by walking in from X. "???": the "???" era tab.
